target_customer: Consumers following longevity diets such as the Blueprint Protocol
problem: Eating a strict organic, seed oil free longevity diet is hard to do at home; Eat Blueprint made inspired meals.

founders.name: Jeff Tang
previous_startups: Athens Research (YC W21, open source note taking, shut down 2023 per a secondary report)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Eat Blueprint is listed under the Athens Research batch.

technical_complexity.rationale: Meal preparation and delivery by local kitchens; no novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Relied on Bryan Johnson's public protocol; anyone could cook to the same recipes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The protocol owner took the business in-house per the YC page.

market_need_then: Blueprint Protocol drew public attention and a $333 per month subscription launched Jan 2024 (Fortune); no direct demand data for Eat Blueprint.

branding.name_origin: Named after the Blueprint Protocol by Bryan Johnson per the YC description.
branding.brand_signature: Association with Bryan Johnson's Blueprint Protocol
branding.community_and_virality: Parent Blueprint brand drew heavy press (Fortune Jan 2024); Eat Blueprint itself not covered.

brand_strength.rationale: Brand borrowed from a famous protocol which helped awareness, but is generic and not owned by the founder.

pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page says it pivoted and was acquired by Bryan Johnson / Blueprint Protocol

outcome_analysis: The YC page says the founder pivoted from the Athens Research note taking app to Eat Blueprint, which Bryan Johnson and Blueprint Protocol then acquired, and lists the company as inactive. Sources found give no dates, price or customer numbers, and Blueprint itself reportedly considered a shutdown or sale in 2025, so the story rests on one YC page and is not well documented.
notes: eatblueprint.com returned 503. Acquisition claim rests on the YC page only. No funding for Eat Blueprint; Athens Research funding (CB Insights $130K, other sources $1.9M to $2M seed in 2021) belongs to the earlier company and is not recorded. Competitors: no dated source for the meal pivot period was found, so the list is empty. Founding year unknown; the YC batch belongs to Athens Research. Directory says Inactive while exit.type is acquisition because the YC page itself states the acquisition; failure factors left empty as no failure cause is documented.
